title: CodeRunnerWire
description: Single source of truth for every message exchanged between the API and the worker, plus the manifest and public API payloads. TS types + zod validators + Go structs are generated from this file. Do not edit generated artifacts by hand.

Limits.title: Limits
Limits.description: Resource limits for a sandbox. The three clocks (wall/idle/cpu) plus memory, pids and output caps.

wallTimeMs.description: Max total lifetime of the session in ms. Kills unconditionally.

idleMs.description: Max ms with no stdout and no stdin before the sandbox is killed.

cpuMs.description: Max accumulated CPU time in ms (cgroup), independent of wall-clock.

memoryMb.description: Memory cap in MiB. memory == memory-swap (no swap).

outputKb.description: Max combined stdout+stderr in KiB before truncation.

maxArtifacts.description: Max number of captured artifact files before excess is dropped (artifactsTruncated=true).

maxArtifactBytes.description: Max total bytes across all captured artifacts before excess is dropped (artifactsTruncated=true).

LimitsOverride.title: LimitsOverride
LimitsOverride.description: Optional per-request override of a subset of Limits.

FileInput.title: FileInput
FileInput.description: A single source file submitted by the caller.

name.description: Relative path written into the sandbox workspace; may contain '/' subdirectories (e.g. data/input.csv). Must not escape the workspace; absolute paths and traversal are rejected.

content.description: File content. Interpreted per `encoding`: utf8 text by default, or base64-encoded arbitrary bytes when encoding=base64.

encoding.description: How content is encoded. utf8=text (default, back-compat); base64=arbitrary bytes.

image.description: Pre-built image with all libs baked in (no runtime dependency resolution).

compile.description: Optional compile command (argv). null for interpreted languages.

interactive.description: Whether the language supports a live interactive stdin session.

preimport.description: Optional zygote pre-import set: importable module/package names the zygote parent loads once at warm time so forked children share their pages copy-on-write. A NON-EMPTY array opts the language into the ZygoteRunner tier (interpreted, heavy-import languages like Python/R); absent or empty routes the language to the DockerSocketRunner tier (compiled or no-import languages like Rust/SQLite). Names are passed verbatim to the language agent (Python: importlib.import_module; R: library()).

LanguageInfo.title: LanguageInfo
LanguageInfo.description: Public language descriptor returned by GET /v1/languages.

version.description: Optional explicit version; if omitted the only/most-recent match is used.

collectOutput.description: Opt-in: when true, the worker accumulates stdout/stderr and captures workspace artifacts into a pullable RunResult (GET /v1/jobs/:id/output). Defaults to false.

channel.description: soketi channel the client must subscribe to (private-run-<jobId>).

JobSpec.title: JobSpec
JobSpec.description: The fully-resolved job the API enqueues for the worker. The API resolves the manifest so the worker stays language-agnostic at runtime.

enqueuedAtMs.description: Unix epoch ms when the API enqueued the job.

collectOutput.description: Resolved opt-in flag from ExecuteRequest; when true the worker persists a RunResult and captures artifacts. The API always writes an explicit boolean (default false).

traceparent.description: W3C trace-context header for cross-seam trace correlation (optional).

StdinMessage.title: StdinMessage
StdinMessage.description: Published on stdin:<jobId>. Carries a chunk to write to the process stdin.

ControlMessage.title: ControlMessage
ControlMessage.description: Published on ctrl:<jobId>. Routes lifecycle control to the owning worker.

timedOut.description: Killed by the wall-clock or cpu clock.

truncated.description: Output exceeded outputKb and was truncated.

Artifact.title: Artifact
Artifact.description: A single file captured from the sandbox working directory, referenced by an object-storage presigned URL. URL-only (no inline bytes): object storage is the single backend.

name.description: Relative file name as written by the program into its working directory (e.g. plot.png).

mimeType.description: Best-effort detected MIME type of the captured file.

bytes.description: Size of the captured file in bytes.

url.description: Presigned GET URL the consumer/browser fetches directly (no bearer).

CompileResult.title: CompileResult
CompileResult.description: Result of the compile stage for compiled languages (Piston-style separate `compile` object). Present in RunResult.compile only when a compile step actually ran. Compiler diagnostics conventionally go to stderr; a non-zero exitCode means compilation failed and the run stage did NOT execute.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the compile command. Non-zero means compilation failed and the run stage did not execute.

signal.description: Signal that terminated the compile command, if any.

stdout.description: Accumulated stdout of the compile command.

stderr.description: Accumulated stderr of the compile command (compiler diagnostics).

output.description: Interleaved stdout+stderr of the compile stage, in emission order (mirrors Piston's compile.output).

durationMs.description: Wall-clock time of the compile stage in ms.

RunResult.title: RunResult
RunResult.description: The persisted, pullable result of a collected run (GET /v1/jobs/:id/output). ResultEvent's terminal fields plus accumulated stdout/stderr and captured artifacts.

timedOut.description: Killed by the wall-clock or cpu clock.

truncated.description: Output exceeded outputKb and was truncated.

stdout.description: Accumulated stdout of the RUN stage (within the outputKb budget; same bytes streamed to soketi). Compile-stage output lives in `compile`, not here.

stderr.description: Accumulated stderr of the RUN stage (within the outputKb budget; same bytes streamed to soketi). Compile-stage diagnostics live in `compile.stderr`, not here.

compile.description: Compile-stage result for compiled languages; absent for interpreted languages or when no compile step ran. Mirrors Piston's separate `compile` object — build logs are kept distinct from the run stdout/stderr.

artifacts.description: Captured workspace artifacts, each referenced by presigned URL.

artifactsTruncated.description: True when captured files exceeded maxArtifacts/maxArtifactBytes and excess was dropped.
